# Usage: ./monitor_pid.sh <PID>
# Returns:

if [[ ${1:-} == "" ]] || [[ ! ${1:-} =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <PID>" >&2
  exit 2
fi

PID="$1"

if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "RUNNING: pid=$PID"
  exit 0
else
  echo "NOT RUNNING: pid=$PID"
  exit 1
fi

arguments.newText:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Usage:
#   ./monitor_pid.sh <PID> [--restart-cmd '<command>']
#
# Behavior:
#   - If PID exists: prints RUNNING and exits 0
#   - If PID does not exist: prints NOT RUNNING, runs restart command (if provided), exits 1
#   - Usage errors exit 2

if [[ ${1:-} == "" ]] || [[ ! ${1:-} =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <PID> [--restart-cmd '<command>']" >&2
  exit 2
fi

PID="$1"
shift || true

RESTART_CMD=""
if [[ ${1:-} == "--restart-cmd" ]]; then
  shift || true
  RESTART_CMD="${1:-}"
  if [[ -z "$RESTART_CMD" ]]; then
    echo "Error: --restart-cmd requires a non-empty command string" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
fi

if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "RUNNING: pid=$PID"
  exit 0
fi

echo "NOT RUNNING: pid=$PID"

if [[ -n "$RESTART_CMD" ]]; then
  echo "RESTARTING: $RESTART_CMD"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  nohup bash -lc "$RESTART_CMD" >/tmp/diagnostic-restart.log 2>&1 &
  echo "RESTART DISPATCHED (pid=$!)"
fi

exit 1
